auditRole: Date-and-vicinity coverage audit; no verified famous-case membership asserted

inputs.productionPinSource: Existing reproduction/release.json r2.files hashes for immutable July31 data; current production configuration uses the same R2 base

summaryShardVerification.method: Read existing compressed bytes in1MiB blocks; compare SHA256 and byte count against every pinned immutable production R2 record; stream one gzip JSON array shard at a time and verify row count

method.dateWindow: Inclusive preset start minus1day through preset end plus1day, matched against sort_date_iso
method.mapping: has_coordinates true, finite numeric latitude[-90,90] and longitude[-180,180]
method.circle: Exact app predicate: wrapped longitude delta[-180,180), x=R*delta_lon_radians*cos(center_latitude), y=R*delta_latitude_radians; x*x+y*y<=radiusMeters*radiusMeters
method.craftOnlyDiagnostic: Exact current app raw Type label membership, independently of craft_type_inferred
notes: Date/vicinity candidates are not verified famous-case members.
Zero mapped vicinity does not establish report absence: unmapped or mislocated rows may exist.
Raw Type Unknown/Sighting can hide rows with recognized inferred craft.
Source, keyword, legend, facility, location-precision and other UI selections are not applied.
Approximate preset centers are not substituted for report coordinates.
